jobsnearme: subagent briefs must forbid `pkill -f`/`killall` patterns — several implementers run identical `vitest run --maxWorkers=3` commands concurrently in sibling worktrees, and a pattern kill can stop another lane's run (FS-307's agent did, 10-3 ~17:30). Kill only your own PIDs.
